description: Opaque cream knee-length linen tunic with narrow brown-gold geometric woven edging around its split neckline and hem, beneath a long open plum-brown outer coat. The coat has restrained gold woven borders down its front, around the sleeve ends and hem. Cream inner cuffs show at the wrists. A narrow brown leather waist belt has a small round gold clasp and a long hanging strap. Brown loose trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the practical civilian outfit. No mantle or head covering is worn. Clothing covers a substantial adult male frame. No armor or weapon is present.
